independence: Read-only reviewer, separate from authors C, D and B; no runtime implementation edits.

findings.finding: Restoring source does not restore compiled mutant artifacts.
findings.resolution: Build and freeze clean binaries, complete replay oracles before mutation, recheck frozen hashes afterward; target artifacts are never accepted after mutation without an explicit clean-source build.

findings.finding: Python optimization disables assertion-based oracle gates.
findings.resolution: All three archived scripts refuse startup when __debug__ is false. The two oracle/mutation scripts were invoked with -O and refused with exit 1.

findings.finding: A literal reference commit did not establish manifest provenance.
findings.resolution: Read and verify the full parser_version commit suffix from each frozen C# manifest, in addition to input SHA, completion and historical raw-output hash. All three match the pinned parser commit.
